newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies to see hot, dry weather to Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies to see hot, dry weather to Aug 1.

text.p: Canada's Prairie grain belt was forecast Wednesday to see mainly hot and dry weather through to Friday, an Environment Canada meteorologist said.
Southern Alberta was forecast to see highs of 28 Celsius Wednesday and 25 Celsius Thursday and Friday with no rain, meteorologist Francois Choquet said.
Central Alberta may see thunderstorms and a risk of hail on Wednesday with a high of 26 Celsius but sunny weather Thursday and Friday with highs of 23 Celsius.
Saskatchewan should see highs of 30 Celsius each day to Friday and no precipitation, Choquet said.
Manitoba should see a high of 27 Celsius Wednesday with strong winds, a chance of early showers Thursday with a high of 30 Celsius and sunny skies Friday with a high of 31 Celsius.
